workItem: Temporarily supersede AAL2 enforcement across normal login, registration, and privileged server checks while preserving enrolled factors, primary Supabase identity validation, and strict provider AAL2 code for staged diagnostic reactivation.
workItemDE: AAL2 vollständig temporär superseden, Faktoren und primäre Supabase-Identität erhalten und Login, Registrierung sowie privilegiertes AAL2 stufenweise anhand von Logs reaktivieren
projectStage: cross-cutting security diagnostic; no productive PVC ownership transfer
priorityReason: Productive Google login stalls around AAL2 choreography; Owner explicitly directed full temporary AAL2 supersession followed by staged reactivation to isolate the failing boundary.
scopeBoundary: All public.profiles rows are read back with mfa_required_account=false; no native factor is deleted or mutated.
Stage 0 removes AAL2 enforcement from normal login, registration/onboarding, and privileged server AAL2 checks.
Primary Supabase identity verification, OAuth bearer validation, IAM role checks, rate limits and subscription authority remain active.
Privileged Stage-0 supersession occurs only after a bearer token resolves to a real Supabase user and is audit logged.
The strict verifyProviderAal2() implementation remains fail-closed and independently testable for Stage 3 restoration.
No email-address or hard-coded user-ID bypass is introduced.
Stage changes require ordinary branch/PR/required-check/Human-CODEOWNER convergence.
No Stripe, Render, secrets, DNS, billing, factor deletion or schema mutation is included.

evidence.supabaseBeforeAfter: 5 profiles total; 0 with mfa_required_account=true; 5 with false; update-to-false returned no rows; 3 profiles retain verified native MFA factors.
evidence.priorPr: #1256 closed unmerged as superseded after Owner expanded diagnostic scope.
evidence.securityBoundary: Owner-directed Stage 0 supersedes AAL2 itself across login, registration and privileged checks; primary identity/IAM remain active and strict provider AAL2 code is retained separately for Stage 3.
evidence.overlap: No open PR writer matched AAL2/MFA/session-composition scope at latest correlation.

acceptanceCriteria: Stage 0 is explicit in one runtime module and disables login, registration and privileged AAL2 requirements.
Normal Google login does not execute native factor/challenge choreography when Stage 0 is active.
Registration still requires profile/consent completion but skips MFA enrollment at Stage 0 and persists mfa_required_account=false.
Existing verified native factors remain present and unchanged.
A nonblocking authenticated server diagnostic checkpoint records stage/account policy for login correlation.
Privileged AAL2 supersession requires a valid primary Supabase bearer identity and records an IAM audit event.
Strict verifyProviderAal2() remains fail-closed and is covered independently by unit/integration tests.
Enterprise tier remains server-authoritative and no provisional Free state is reintroduced.
Reactivation order is Stage 1 login, Stage 2 registration, Stage 3 privileged AAL2.
Focused and full required tests pass on exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
